headline: M-STOR jumps 26.85% while BKD surges 10.62% on a 165.3σ volume spike, amid multiple REIT capital changes.
market_take: Today's coverage shows strong upside in PF&REIT and CONMAT, led by M-STOR (+26.85%) and BKD (+10.62%) with extraordinary trading volumes. The PROP sector is under pressure, with PF down 20.00% and A down 13.86%. Food stocks display mixed moves, highlighted by AQUA's -9.09% open gap and CH's volatile +13.37% gap followed by -11.28% intraday decline. Several REITs announced capital reductions, and a CONMAT merger filing (SCC) adds corporate activity.

sector_notes.note: AQUA opened with a -9.09% gap and fell 9.09% overall; CH showed a +13.37% open gap but reversed with an -11.28% intraday move, while PRG posted a 13.2σ volume spike.
PF dropped 20.00% and A fell 13.86%, both on modest volume; CGD added a -10.00% move, and MBK and J each slipped over 5%.
BKD rose 10.62% with a 165.3σ volume spike and a +9.65% intraday rise; NL surged 9.84% on a 240.5σ volume spike; TPOLY opened down 10.00% and filed a financial‑transaction disclosure.
M-STOR led the sector with a +26.85% gain; multiple REITs (LHRREIT, QHBREIT, CPNCG, BOFFICE) reported capital reductions, and FTREIT disclosed an acquisition of additional assets.
DCON opened with a +7.14% gap; PPP experienced a -100.00% open gap; SCC filed a merger and partnership announcement in the paper‑packaging industry.
